fieldNotes.truckGate: Main truck drive off E Highland Rd (west curb cut) is a wide open multi-lane concrete drive with no barrier, gate, or booth (Street View 2021-09). A secondary east drive has a manual chain-link sliding gate with a Pepsi sign, but it is not the primary controlled entrance.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Main drive is a very wide unmarked concrete apron; no painted lane separation, so lane counts left null.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock banks on the NE (gray) building face (~12-14 trailers docked) plus the main building SE corner bank (~8-10) and east-face positions; band 25-50 is an overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Dense trailer rows fill the east yard between the building and the pond, running from the rail corridor to E Highland Rd; 60+ drop positions plus a long nose-in row along the pond edge.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: A dark-roof warehouse parcel at the SE corner sits inside the traced perimeter; Pepsi blue bottle shells are stacked around it (Street View), so it appears operationally Pepsi, but parcel ownership was not verified.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two physically distinct dock clusters (NE gray-building bank vs main-building SE/east banks) suggest separate ship/receive; inferred from overhead only.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail corridor runs along the north boundary but no spur visibly enters the property.
